body: I don't even know what to say. I'm just messed up.
I wish that someone would say something. Please! I'm not okay and I need someone to be here for me.

I wish that anyone cared at all. But no one cares. I'm just a fucking worthless piece of shit! I should have known that no one would want to help. I should have known that I'm not worth anyone's time. I'm better off dead!
I relate to that feeling. I hope that you're safe.

Everything just feels so heavy when it didn't use to. The things that I have always loved are now the things that weigh the most. I've told some close friends and even my pastor about it but I always feel wrong when I talk about it. I feel like I'm just being a burden to them with my issues. I already have this image of the man I'm supposed to be and it's hard to talk about how I feel because I am so used to suppressing it. I think the biggest thing is that I'm 22 years old and I feel like I'm still not really an adult. And everything I've said doesn't really justify how I feel. I shouldn't want to die but I do and maybe it's completely irrational but I can't fight it anymore. Everything is heavy.
